name: Zainab Noor
title: Learning Experience Designer / Instructional Designer
tagline: I create scenario-based eLearning that puts people in realistic workplace situations, lets them practice the decisions that matter, and closes real skill gaps, so your team performs better instead of just finishing a course.
aboutBio: I'm a Learning Experience Designer and Instructional Designer. I turn complex content into scenario-based learning that people can apply on the job.

My background brings design and learning together: graphic and presentation design, teaching support for adult nursing students as a Teaching Assistant, and curriculum development for nursing courses.
That mix shapes how I work. I start from what learners need to do, write measurable objectives, align practice and assessment with real tasks, and design every screen for clarity.
I'm now focused on corporate learning, helping teams close skill gaps with scenario-based eLearning that is engaging, accessible, and built to support business goals.
